hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 custom-curve swap between native ETH and phiEth (an ETH-wrapper ERC-20) by intercepting beforeSwap, taking the full input amount, converting via phiEth.deposit/withdraw, and returning the full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Liquidity additions are blocked and pool initialization is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
